alphabetItems.title: ا
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Alif (Urdu vowel)
alphabetItems.signName: Closed fist with thumb upright alongside
visualCueSteps: Make a gentle closed fist.
Let your thumb stand tall alongside your fingers.
Palm faces forward like a little mountain!
alphabetItems.funFact: ا is for انار (anaar) — a juicy pomegranate!

alphabetItems.title: ب
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Be
alphabetItems.signName: Four fingers up together, thumb folded into palm
visualCueSteps: Hold four fingers straight up, touching.
Tuck your thumb into your palm.
Show your palm to the screen like an open window!
alphabetItems.funFact: ب is for بکری (bakri) — a silly goat!

alphabetItems.title: پ
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Pe
alphabetItems.signName: Open hand of ب, turned as shown in the photo
visualCueSteps: Start like ب — four fingers up.
Look at the real photo and match the gentle tilt.
پ has three dots above the letter — count them!
alphabetItems.funFact: پ is for پتنگ (patang) — a dancing kite!

alphabetItems.title: ت
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Te
alphabetItems.signName: Index finger up, thumb resting across the hand
visualCueSteps: Lift your index finger straight up.
Let your thumb rest across your middle finger.
ت has two dots above the letter!
alphabetItems.funFact: ت is for تتلی (titli) — a fluttery butterfly!

alphabetItems.title: ٹ
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Tte
alphabetItems.signName: Soft closed fist, thumb placed as in the photo
visualCueSteps: Make a soft closed fist.
Look at the photo and copy where your thumb sits.
ٹ is ت wearing a little cap on top!
alphabetItems.funFact: ٹ is for ٹوپی (topi) — a cosy cap!

alphabetItems.title: ث
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Se
alphabetItems.signName: Index curved into a hook, thumb touches it
visualCueSteps: Curve your index finger into a little hook.
Touch your thumb gently to it.
ث wears three dots on top!
alphabetItems.funFact: ث is for ثمر (samar) — sweet fruit!

alphabetItems.title: ج
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Jim
alphabetItems.signName: Fist with index finger up, tip curled like a hook
visualCueSteps: Make a fist with your index finger up.
Curl the top of your index finger like a tiny hook.
ج has one dot tucked inside the hook!
alphabetItems.funFact: ج is for جہاز (jahaaz) — a flying aeroplane!

alphabetItems.title: چ
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Che
alphabetItems.signName: Two fingers together, pointing to the side
visualCueSteps: Point your index and middle fingers to the side.
Hold them together like a little arrow.
چ has three dots floating below!
alphabetItems.funFact: چ is for چاند (chaand) — the glowing moon!

alphabetItems.title: ح
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter He
alphabetItems.signName: Two fingers together pointing aside, gently curled
visualCueSteps: Hold two fingers together, pointing to the side.
Curl them gently like a flower stem.
ح has no dot at all!
alphabetItems.funFact: ح is for حلوہ (halwa) — a warm sweet treat!

alphabetItems.title: خ
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Khe
alphabetItems.signName: Fingers opened wide as shown in the photo
visualCueSteps: Open your fingers wide like the photo.
Check where your thumb sits carefully.
خ has one dot sitting on top!
alphabetItems.funFact: خ is for خربوزہ (kharbooza) — a big melon!

alphabetItems.title: د
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Dal
alphabetItems.signName: Index finger bent into a hook, pointing down
visualCueSteps: Bend your index finger into a hook.
Point it gently downwards.
د is long and smooth with no dots!
alphabetItems.funFact: د is for دروازہ (darwaza) — a big door!

alphabetItems.title: ڈ
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Dhal
alphabetItems.signName: Index finger up, thumb and middle finger form a circle
visualCueSteps: Point your index finger up to the sky.
Touch your thumb to your middle finger — a little circle!
ڈ is د wearing a hat on top!
alphabetItems.funFact: ڈ is for ڈھول (dhol) — a loud drum!

alphabetItems.title: ذ
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Zal
alphabetItems.signName: د hook shape, hand turned as in the photo
visualCueSteps: Make د's hook shape with your finger.
Turn your hand gently downwards like the photo.
ذ has one dot above it!
alphabetItems.funFact: ذ is for ذخیرہ (zakheera) — a treasure store!

alphabetItems.title: ر
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Re
alphabetItems.signName: Index crossed over middle finger
visualCueSteps: Cross your index finger over your middle finger.
Point them gently up.
ر flows like a little wave!
alphabetItems.funFact: ر is for روٹی (roti) — warm bread!

alphabetItems.title: ڑ
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Rre
alphabetItems.signName: Index and middle in a wide V
visualCueSteps: Hold up your index and middle finger in a wide V.
Match the spread in the real photo.
ڑ never starts a word — it hides inside, like بارش!
alphabetItems.funFact: ڑ hides inside words like بارش (barish) — rain!

alphabetItems.title: ز
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Ze
alphabetItems.signName: Index finger pointing to the side
visualCueSteps: Point your index finger to the side.
Keep the rest folded in your fist.
ز has one dot above it!
alphabetItems.funFact: ز is for زیبرا — striped zebra!

alphabetItems.title: ژ
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Zhe
alphabetItems.signName: Two fingers up together, side by side
visualCueSteps: Hold two fingers up together, side by side.
Match your hand to the photo.
ژ is ز with three extra dots!
alphabetItems.funFact: ژ lives in ژالہ (zaala) — falling hail!

alphabetItems.title: س
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Seen
alphabetItems.signName: Soft closed fist as in the photo
visualCueSteps: Close your fingers into a soft fist.
Look at the photo for the gentle curve.
س flows like three little hills!
alphabetItems.funFact: س is for سیب (seb) — a crunchy apple!

alphabetItems.title: ش
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Sheen
alphabetItems.signName: Index curled over a closed fist
visualCueSteps: Curl your index finger over your closed fist.
Match the shape in the photo.
ش has three dots dancing above!
alphabetItems.funFact: ش is for شیر (sher) — a roaring lion!

alphabetItems.title: ص
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Swad
alphabetItems.signName: Fist with thumb up, palm turned towards you
visualCueSteps: Make a closed fist with your thumb up — like ا!
Turn your palm gently towards you.
ص starts with a little oval shape!
alphabetItems.funFact: ص is for صابن (sabun) — bubbly soap!

alphabetItems.title: ض
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Zwad
alphabetItems.signName: Index and pinky up, middle fingers held by thumb
visualCueSteps: Lift your index finger and smallest finger.
Fold your middle fingers and hold them with your thumb.
ض is ص wearing one dot!
alphabetItems.funFact: ض is for ضرب (zarb) — multiplying numbers!

alphabetItems.title: ط
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Toay
alphabetItems.signName: Index up, thumb and middle finger make a circle
visualCueSteps: Point your index finger up.
Make a circle with your thumb and middle finger under it.
ط is tall and elegant with no dots!
alphabetItems.funFact: ط is for طوطا (tota) — a talking parrot!

alphabetItems.title: ظ
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Zoay
alphabetItems.signName: Thumb touches index tip, other fingers open wide
visualCueSteps: Touch your thumb to your index fingertip.
Let your other fingers open wide like a flower.
ظ has one dot above!
alphabetItems.funFact: ظ is for ظرف (zarf) — a shining pot!

alphabetItems.title: ع
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Ain
alphabetItems.signName: Hand down, thumb and index curved towards each other
visualCueSteps: Point your hand downwards.
Curve your thumb and index towards each other like a beak.
ع has a tiny س shape on top!
alphabetItems.funFact: ع is for عینک (ainak) — bright glasses!

alphabetItems.title: غ
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Ghain
alphabetItems.signName: Like ع, with one dot above
visualCueSteps: Make ع's shape with your hand.
Ghain looks just like Ain — with a dot!
غ has one dot above!
alphabetItems.funFact: غ is for غبارہ (ghubara) — a flying balloon!

alphabetItems.title: ف
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Fay
alphabetItems.signName: Fingers together pointing up, thumb out to the side
visualCueSteps: Hold your fingers together pointing up.
Let your thumb rest out to the side.
ف has one dot above!
alphabetItems.funFact: ف is for فٹبال — goal! football!

alphabetItems.title: ق
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Qaf
alphabetItems.signName: Two fingers pointing downwards
visualCueSteps: Point two fingers downwards like the photo.
ق is ک with two dots above!
Practise this one with your teacher — the camera cannot see it yet.
alphabetItems.funFact: ق is for قلم (qalam) — a clever pen!

alphabetItems.title: ک
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Kaf
alphabetItems.signName: Index and middle in a wide V, thumb out
visualCueSteps: Open index and middle finger in a wide V.
Let your thumb peek out to the side.
ک opens like friendly scissors!
alphabetItems.funFact: ک is for کتاب (kitaab) — a book of stories!

alphabetItems.title: گ
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Gaf
alphabetItems.signName: Index finger pointing to the side
visualCueSteps: Point your index finger to the side.
Keep your fist snug and strong.
گ is ک with an extra line on top!
alphabetItems.funFact: گ is for گاڑی (gaari) — a zooming car!

alphabetItems.title: ل
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Laam
alphabetItems.signName: Index finger up, thumb out to the side
visualCueSteps: Point your index finger up to the sky.
Stretch your thumb out to the side.
ل is tall like a flagpole!
alphabetItems.funFact: ل is for لڈو (laddu) — a round sweet!

alphabetItems.title: م
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Meem
alphabetItems.signName: Fist folded, pointing downwards
visualCueSteps: Fold your fingers over into a soft fist.
Point your hand gently downwards.
م has a small circle below!
Practise with a grown-up — the camera cannot see م yet.
alphabetItems.funFact: م is for مچھلی (machhli) — a swimming fish!

alphabetItems.title: ن
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Noon
alphabetItems.signName: Hand down, fingertips curled gently in
visualCueSteps: Point your hand downwards.
Curl your fingertips gently in like the photo.
ن has one dot above!
alphabetItems.funFact: ن is for ناریل (nariyal) — a hard coconut!

alphabetItems.title: و
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Vao (Urdu vowel)
alphabetItems.signName: Gentle closed fist as in the photo
visualCueSteps: Make a gentle closed fist.
Match the photo for your thumb's position.
و joins words together — it means 'and'!
alphabetItems.funFact: و is for وضو (wuzu) — fresh and clean!

alphabetItems.title: ہ
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Hay
alphabetItems.signName: Index and middle in a wide V
visualCueSteps: Open index and middle finger in a wide V.
Look at the photo for the gentle angle.
ہ is round like a little drum!
alphabetItems.funFact: ہ is for ہاتھ (haath) — your helping hand!

alphabetItems.title: ی
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Chhoti Yeh (Urdu vowel)
alphabetItems.signName: Closed fist with smallest finger raised
visualCueSteps: Make a closed fist.
Raise your smallest finger up proudly!
ی has two dots below!
alphabetItems.funFact: ی is for یاقوت (yaqoot) — a red ruby!

alphabetItems.title: ے
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Bari Yeh (Urdu vowel)
alphabetItems.signName: Index finger straight up, thumb out to the side
visualCueSteps: Point your index finger straight up.
Let your thumb rest out to the side.
ے never starts a word — it finishes them, like کھیل!
alphabetItems.funFact: ے finishes words like کھیل (khel) — play!

alphabetItems.title: ء
alphabetItems.subtitle: PSL Letter Hamza
alphabetItems.signName: Thumb and index fingertips pinch into a tiny circle
visualCueSteps: Pinch your thumb and index fingertips together.
Make a tiny circle — small but powerful!
ء hops around inside words!
alphabetItems.funFact: ء is hamza — it hops around inside words!

englishAlphabetItems.title: A
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter A (ASL vowel)
englishAlphabetItems.signName: Fist with Thumb Upright on Side
visualCueSteps: Make a gentle closed fist with your fingers folded.
Rest thumb straight up alongside your index finger.
Palm faces outward towards the screen!
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: A is for Apple! Thumb points upright to the sky.

englishAlphabetItems.title: B
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter B (ASL)
englishAlphabetItems.signName: Four Fingers Flat, Thumb Across Palm
visualCueSteps: Hold all four fingers upright and touching.
Tuck your thumb across into your palm.
Palm faces forward like an open window.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: B is for Bear! Tall and friendly like bear paws.

englishAlphabetItems.title: C
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter C (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Curve fingers and thumb into a half-circle.
Looks just like the letter 'C' from the side!
Keep your wrist relaxed and gentle.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: C is for Cat! The curved shape is like a curled sleeping kitten.

englishAlphabetItems.title: D
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter D (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Point your index finger straight up to the sky.
Touch thumb to middle, ring, and pinky tips in a circle.
Makes the tall back and round belly of letter D!
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: D is for Dog! Index points up like a happy puppy tail.

englishAlphabetItems.title: E
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter E (ASL vowel)
visualCueSteps: Bend all four fingers down like little claws.
Tuck thumb horizontally underneath fingertips.
Show your curled nails forward.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: E is for Elephant! Curled fingers look like little elephant toes!

englishAlphabetItems.title: F
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter F (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Touch index finger and thumb tips together (OK shape).
Keep middle, ring, and pinky straight up and separated.
Palm faces outward proudly.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: F is for Fox! Three tall fingers look like playful fox ears.

englishAlphabetItems.title: G
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter G (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Point index finger horizontally to the side.
Extend thumb parallel to index finger like a small pinch.
Curl remaining three fingers into palm.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: G is for Giraffe! Sideways fingers look like a giraffe snacking on leaves.

englishAlphabetItems.title: H
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter H (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Extend index and middle fingers together horizontally.
Rest thumb tucked over ring and pinky fingers.
Fingers point across your body.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: H is for Horse! Two fingers galloping side by side!

englishAlphabetItems.title: I
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter I (ASL vowel)
visualCueSteps: Fold all fingers into a tight fist with thumb over.
Point ONLY your pinky finger straight up into the air!
Hold pinky tall and proud like a magic wand.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: I is for Ice Cream! Pinky looks like an ice cream cone stick.

englishAlphabetItems.title: J
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter J (ASL)
englishAlphabetItems.signName: Pinky Finger Drawing a Hook 'J' in the Air
visualCueSteps: Start with pinky up (like letter 'I').
Swoop your pinky down and curve up into a 'J' hook!
Add a fun little bounce at the finish.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: J is for Yo-Yo! Pinky swoops down and catches like a spinning yo-yo!

englishAlphabetItems.title: K
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter K (ASL)
englishAlphabetItems.signName: Peace Sign with Thumb between Fingers
visualCueSteps: Raise index and middle fingers in a V.
Place your thumb tip right between them pointing up.
Tuck ring and pinky fingers down.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: K is for Kangaroo! The thumb stands in the pouch between fingers!

englishAlphabetItems.title: L
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter L (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Point index finger straight up.
Stick thumb straight out to the side.
Forms a clear, sharp 'L' angle!
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: L is for Lion! Strong and proud 'L' shape.

englishAlphabetItems.title: M
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter M (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Tuck thumb into palm under first 3 fingers.
Fold index, middle, and ring fingers over thumb.
Pinky stays folded at the end; 3 little bumps show.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: M is for Monkey! Three finger bumps like three mountains.

englishAlphabetItems.title: N
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter N (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Tuck thumb under index and middle fingers.
Drape index and middle fingers down over thumb.
Ring and pinky stay tucked; 2 bumps show.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: N is for Nest! Two snug eggs resting over the thumb.

englishAlphabetItems.title: O
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter O (ASL vowel)
visualCueSteps: Curve fingers in a gentle arc.
Touch all four fingertips to thumb tip.
Create an open circle you can peek through!
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: O is for Orange! A perfect round orange hand shape.

englishAlphabetItems.title: P
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter P (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Form the 'K' sign (index and middle up with thumb between).
Tilt your wrist forward so fingers point down towards the floor.
Middle finger points straight down.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: P is for Panda! Like a peaceful panda resting paws.

englishAlphabetItems.title: Q
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter Q (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Make the 'G' pincher shape (thumb and index parallel).
Point both thumb and index down towards the ground.
Keep other fingers tucked in.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: Q is for Queen! Pointing down like a royal sceptre.

englishAlphabetItems.title: R
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter R (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Cross your middle finger over your index finger.
Keep both fingers straight and standing tall.
Tuck thumb over ring and pinky fingers.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: R is for Rabbit! Like crossing fingers for good luck and happy hops!

englishAlphabetItems.title: S
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter S (ASL)
englishAlphabetItems.signName: Closed Fist with Thumb Across Fingers
visualCueSteps: Make a tight fist with all 4 fingers folded in.
Wrap your thumb across the FRONT of your fingers.
Notice thumb is over fingers (unlike 'A' where it is on the side).
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: S is for Star! A tight, cozy fist shining bright like a star.

englishAlphabetItems.title: T
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter T (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Poke your thumb tip out between index and middle finger.
Fold fingers down into a fist over the thumb.
Only the thumb knuckle peeks through under index.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: T is for Tiger! Thumb peeks out like a playful tiger cub.

englishAlphabetItems.title: U
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter U (ASL vowel)
englishAlphabetItems.signName: Two Fingers Glued Together Straight Up
visualCueSteps: Raise index and middle fingers together.
Press both fingers tight against each other with no gap!
Tuck thumb over ring and pinky.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: U is for Umbrella! Two fingers stay together to keep dry!

englishAlphabetItems.title: V
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter V (ASL)
englishAlphabetItems.signName: Index & Middle Finger in a V Shape
visualCueSteps: Raise index and middle fingers tall.
Spread them apart into a wide 'V' peace sign!
Tuck thumb over ring and pinky fingers.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: V is for Violin! The open 'V' creates music and harmony.

englishAlphabetItems.title: W
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter W (ASL)
englishAlphabetItems.signName: Three Middle Fingers Up (Index, Middle, Ring)
visualCueSteps: Hold up index, middle, and ring fingers spread apart.
Touch thumb tip to pinky tip.
Three tall fingers form the peaks of 'W'!
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: W is for Waves! Three fingers rolling like ocean waves.

englishAlphabetItems.title: X
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter X (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Make a fist with thumb tucked.
Raise index finger and bend its top knuckle into a hook.
Looks like a pirate captain's hook!
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: X marks the spot! Hooked finger finds the secret treasure chest.

englishAlphabetItems.title: Y
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter Y (ASL)
visualCueSteps: Stick your thumb straight out to one side.
Stick your pinky straight out to the other side.
Fold the three middle fingers tightly against your palm.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: Y is for Yacht! Wide horns rocking gently on gentle waters.

englishAlphabetItems.title: Z
englishAlphabetItems.subtitle: English Letter Z (ASL)
englishAlphabetItems.signName: Index Finger Tracing a 'Z' in the Air
visualCueSteps: Point your index finger straight forward.
Trace across, diagonal down, and across to draw a 'Z' in the air!
Lightning fast like a friendly zigzag.
englishAlphabetItems.funFact: Z is for Zebra! Tracing stripes in the air with lightning speed!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 0
numberItems.signName: PSL number sign for 0 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Count 0 little stars or blocks with your finger.
Show the number sign your teacher uses for 0.
Point at the number and count out loud together!
numberItems.funFact: 0 ⭐ objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 1
numberItems.signName: PSL number sign for 1 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Count 1 little stars or blocks with your finger.
Show the number sign your teacher uses for 1.
Point at the number and count out loud together!
numberItems.funFact: 1 ⭐ objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 2
numberItems.signName: PSL number sign for 2 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Count 2 little stars or blocks with your finger.
Show the number sign your teacher uses for 2.
Point at the number and count out loud together!
numberItems.funFact: 2 🐰 objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 3
numberItems.signName: PSL number sign for 3 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Count 3 little stars or blocks with your finger.
Show the number sign your teacher uses for 3.
Point at the number and count out loud together!
numberItems.funFact: 3 🎈 objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 4
numberItems.signName: PSL number sign for 4 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Count 4 little stars or blocks with your finger.
Show the number sign your teacher uses for 4.
Point at the number and count out loud together!
numberItems.funFact: 4 🦋 objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 5
numberItems.signName: PSL number sign for 5 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Count 5 little stars or blocks with your finger.
Show the number sign your teacher uses for 5.
Point at the number and count out loud together!
numberItems.funFact: 5 🖐️ objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 6
numberItems.signName: PSL number sign for 6 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Collect 6 small things like leaves or buttons.
Practise the PSL number sign for 6 with a grown-up.
Line up your treasures and count them again!
numberItems.funFact: 6 🍓 objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 7
numberItems.signName: PSL number sign for 7 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Collect 7 small things like leaves or buttons.
Practise the PSL number sign for 7 with a grown-up.
Line up your treasures and count them again!
numberItems.funFact: 7 🌈 objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 8
numberItems.signName: PSL number sign for 8 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Collect 8 small things like leaves or buttons.
Practise the PSL number sign for 8 with a grown-up.
Line up your treasures and count them again!
numberItems.funFact: 8 🐙 objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 9
numberItems.signName: PSL number sign for 9 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Collect 9 small things like leaves or buttons.
Practise the PSL number sign for 9 with a grown-up.
Line up your treasures and count them again!
numberItems.funFact: 9 💎 objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 10
numberItems.signName: PSL number sign for 10 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Collect 10 small things like leaves or buttons.
Practise the PSL number sign for 10 with a grown-up.
Line up your treasures and count them again!
numberItems.funFact: 10 🌟 objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 11
numberItems.signName: Compound sign for 11 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Break 11 into 1 tens and 1 ones.
Practise both number signs slowly, then together.
Count blocks, spoons or steps to reach 11!
numberItems.funFact: 11 🍎 objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 12
numberItems.signName: Compound sign for 12 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Break 12 into 1 tens and 2 ones.
Practise both number signs slowly, then together.
Count blocks, spoons or steps to reach 12!
numberItems.funFact: 12 🚗 objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 13
numberItems.signName: Compound sign for 13 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Break 13 into 1 tens and 3 ones.
Practise both number signs slowly, then together.
Count blocks, spoons or steps to reach 13!
numberItems.funFact: 13 🌸 objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 14
numberItems.signName: Compound sign for 14 — learn it with your teacher
visualCueSteps: Break 14 into 1 tens and 4 ones.
Practise both number signs slowly, then together.
Count blocks, spoons or steps to reach 14!
numberItems.funFact: 14 🧁 objects! You're an incredible math & sign explorer!

numberItems.subtitle: Number 15
numberItems.signName: Compound sign for 15 — learn it with your teacher

vocabularyItems.title: Hello
vocabularyItems.subtitle: Greeting Word
vocabularyItems.signName: Learned together with a PSL teacher
visualCueSteps: Wave your hand warmly, just like the photo of a friendly hello.
Practise the PSL sign with your teacher or family.
Smile — faces talk too!
vocabularyItems.funFact: A warm hello can be waved, signed, or smiled!

vocabularyItems.title: Thank You
vocabularyItems.subtitle: Polite Word
vocabularyItems.signName: Learned together with a PSL teacher
visualCueSteps: Think of something kind someone did for you today.
Learn the PSL sign for Thank You with your teacher.
Say it with your whole face, not just your hands!
vocabularyItems.funFact: Thanking a friend makes both hearts warm!

vocabularyItems.title: Water
vocabularyItems.subtitle: Drink Word
vocabularyItems.signName: Learned together with a PSL teacher
visualCueSteps: When you feel thirsty, show your teacher the PSL sign for Water.
Practise it together before snack time.
Water keeps your brain strong for learning!
vocabularyItems.funFact: Asking for water by sign is a real superpower!

vocabularyItems.title: Friend
vocabularyItems.subtitle: Social Word
vocabularyItems.signName: Learned together with a PSL teacher
visualCueSteps: Think of your best friend and their name in signs.
Learn the PSL sign for Friend with your teacher.
Friends can sign to each other across the room!
vocabularyItems.funFact: Friendship signs are like secret handshakes!

vocabularyItems.title: Book
vocabularyItems.subtitle: School Word
vocabularyItems.signName: Learned together with a PSL teacher
visualCueSteps: Hold an imaginary book in your hands.
Learn the PSL sign for Book with your teacher.
Every book is an adventure waiting for you!
vocabularyItems.funFact: Books open worlds — and signs open books!

vocabularyItems.title: Happy
vocabularyItems.subtitle: Feeling Word
vocabularyItems.signName: Learned together with a PSL teacher
visualCueSteps: Touch your chest — can you feel your happy heartbeat?
Learn the PSL sign for Happy with your teacher.
Show your happy face together with the sign!
vocabularyItems.funFact: Happiness shows in hands and faces at the same time!

vocabularyItems.title: School
vocabularyItems.subtitle: Place Word
vocabularyItems.signName: Learned together with a PSL teacher
visualCueSteps: Think about your classroom and your friends there.
Learn the PSL sign for School with your teacher.
Sign it every morning when you arrive!
vocabularyItems.funFact: School is where signs and friends grow!

vocabularyItems.title: Love
vocabularyItems.subtitle: Heart Word
vocabularyItems.signName: Learned together with a PSL teacher
visualCueSteps: Hug yourself gently — that is what love feels like.
Learn the PSL sign for Love with your teacher.
Send a sign of love to someone far away!
vocabularyItems.funFact: Love is the first sign many families learn!

levels.title: Level 1: Urdu Vowels & Counting 1-5
levels.subtitle: Starting Irssa's Journey
levels.description: Meet the Urdu vowels ا, و, ی and ے and practise counting 1 to 5.

levels.title: Level 2: First Letters & Numbers 6-20
levels.subtitle: Expanding Vocabulary
levels.description: Learn the first twelve PSL letters and count all the way to 20.

levels.title: Level 3: More Letters & Numbers 21-35
levels.subtitle: Completing the PSL Alphabet
levels.description: Finish the remaining PSL letters, learn everyday words, and count to 35!

levels.title: Level 4: Counting 36 to 50 & School Words
levels.subtitle: Ready for Classroom
levels.description: Reach the big 50 in counting! Learn words for School, Books, and Love.

levels.title: Level 5: Master Sign Hero (Speed Challenge)
levels.subtitle: The Ultimate Champion
levels.description: Test your skills across the PSL alphabet and 50 numbers in Camera Studio and Speed Match!

presets.name: Gentle Fist
presets.bodyDescription: Hand at chest height, thumb upright against folded fingers
presets.funHint: ا is for Anaar! Thumb stands tall like a mountain

presets.name: Flat Four Palm
presets.bodyDescription: Four fingers straight up, thumb tucked across palm
presets.funHint: ب is for Bakri! Tall and steady like a goat

presets.name: Curved Beak
presets.bodyDescription: Thumb and index curved towards each other, hand pointing down
presets.funHint: ع is for Ainak! A little beak for glasses

presets.name: Index Circle
presets.bodyDescription: Index finger tall to the sky, thumb and middle finger make a circle
presets.funHint: ڈ is for Dhol! Boom boom drum finger

presets.name: Soft Fist
presets.bodyDescription: Fingers closed into a soft, gentle fist
presets.funHint: س is for Seb! Three hills in one letter

presets.name: Circle Under Index
presets.bodyDescription: Index finger up, thumb and middle finger circle beneath it
presets.funHint: ط is for Tota! A proud parrot finger

presets.name: Two Fingers Side
presets.bodyDescription: Index and middle fingers together, pointing to the side
presets.funHint: چ is for Chaand! Three dots under the moon

presets.name: Pinky Tall
presets.bodyDescription: Fist closed, little pinky finger pointing straight up
presets.funHint: ی is for Yaqoot! The small finger shines

presets.name: L-Shape Hand
presets.bodyDescription: Index finger up, thumb extended to form a right angle
presets.funHint: ل is for Laddu! Tall and proud like a flagpole

presets.name: Tiny Ring
presets.bodyDescription: Thumb and fingertips meet in a small round ring
presets.funHint: و joins words together — it means 'and'!

presets.name: Crossed Fingers
presets.bodyDescription: Index finger crossed over middle finger
presets.funHint: ر is for Roti! A warm wave shape

presets.name: Wide V
presets.bodyDescription: Index and middle spread apart in a tall V-shape
presets.funHint: ک is for Kitaab! Friendly open scissors

presets.name: Wide Open Fingers
presets.bodyDescription: Fingers opened wide apart, as in the photo
presets.funHint: خ is for Kharbooza! One dot on top

presets.name: Two Tall Fingers
presets.bodyDescription: Index and smallest finger up, middle fingers held by thumb
presets.funHint: ض is for Zarb! ص wearing a dot

presets.name: Open Palm
presets.bodyDescription: Fingers together pointing up, thumb out to the side

presets.name: Waving Hand
presets.bodyDescription: Hand waving gently side to side at eye level

presets.name: Hands Over Heart
presets.bodyDescription: Both hands crossed flat over heart / chest
presets.funHint: A sign of love and warmth from Irssa's heart
